coercion.description_observed: Preserve strings byte-for-text; convert only integral numeric cells to base-10 text; preserve null; reject every other cell type.
coercion.event_time_local: Require a timezone-naive datetime and preserve microseconds; never attach or infer a timezone.
coercion.identifiers: Preserve source strings without trimming or case normalization; convert only integral numeric cells to base-10 text without a .0 suffix; reject booleans, null required identifiers, fractional numbers, and other cell types.
coercion.invoice_is_cancellation: True exactly when source_invoice_id starts with uppercase C; comparison is case-sensitive.
coercion.quantity: Require an integral numeric value in the inclusive signed-int64 range -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807 and preserve its sign.
coercion.unit_price: Construct Decimal from the parser value's base-10 string, require exact fit in decimal128(18,3), preserve sign, and never round.

event_id.row_number_semantics: 1-based physical Excel row including the header

forbidden_transformations: cross-sheet or within-sheet tuple deduplication outside the accepted sheet-boundary stitch
trimming or case normalization of observed strings
absolute-value conversion, clipping, winsorization, or removal of signed/extreme values
future-derived enrichment or backward filling of descriptions, prices, codes, or aggregates
manufacturing marketplace listing, supply, competition, independent-demand, or product-universe fields
ordering: Accepted sheet order followed by ascending physical source_row_number within each retained sheet.

point_in_time.as_of_rule: A future consumer at cutoff t may use only rows where event_time_local <= t.
point_in_time.future_target_rule: A separately authorized future target must begin strictly after t.
